Paul Onuachu has also been listed among Trabzonspor's injury concerns, while Sidny Lopes Cabral is suspended following his dismissal against Hearts.

Mohamed Salah has scored in both of the club's Conference League matches so far and should again be an important figure in the final third.

Julian Schuster's side beat Jablonec before suffering a 3-0 defeat away to Monaco, leaving them with three points from their first two fixtures in this competition. [...] Trabzonspor have several injury concerns ahead of Thursday's match, as Aral Simsir and Franculino were unavailable for the recent fixture against Gaziantep, while Cihan Canak and Onuralp Cevikkan are also carrying muscle problems and are doubtful.

Arseniy Batagov is expected to remain out with a hamstring injury, while Ruslan Malinovskyi and Okay Yokuslu are also sidelined. [...] Freiburg have recovered from consecutive defeats against Bayer Leverkusen, Monaco and Bayern Munich by beating Wolfsburg 3-2 in the DFB-Pokal before securing a 2-1 away victory over Augsburg.

However, the visitors have struggled to maintain consistency away from home in European competition, losing four of their last five such matches.

Freiburg are expected to be without Philipp Treu, who has an ankle injury, while Florent Muslija remains a long-term absentee with a cruciate ligament injury.
